fractals.name: Fractals: Rules, Scale and Room to Move
fractals.truth: A finite construction lets us investigate repeated rules, scale, removal and the cost of further detail.
fractals.qfep_connection: Ask which differences a chosen rule and computational budget preserve, and what bodily possibilities follow. Geometry, connectivity, cost and measured uncertainty require separate observations; this sequence does not identify recursion depth with entropy or a universal critical threshold.
fractals.formula: For equal-scale separated self-similar copies: D = log(N) / log(S), where S is the inverse scale factor.
fractals.demonstration: Compare a single call with branching, inspect retained and removed parts, follow openings through a finite Menger specimen, and distinguish a numerical recurrence from its spatial display.
fractals.description: From recursive calls and branching to repeated removal, measured detail and a porous volume; then numerical recurrence and a comparison that prepares symbolic rewriting in L-systems.
learning_objectives: Distinguish a recursive procedure, a numerical recurrence and fractal structure.
Predict one generation before observing the next; locate the stopping condition.
Compare branching, replacement and removal at fixed outer scale.
Relate retained parts and sample resolution to computation and visible detail.
Distinguish geometrical openings, collision support and passages a particular body can traverse.
Translate a familiar construction into the rule and interpretation stages of an L-system.
content: Fractal_Recursion: Recursion Calls Itself — the function that calls itself
Fractal_RecursiveTrees: Branching Without Blueprints — deterministic vs stochastic trees, inverted roots, fractal forests
Fractal_CantorSet: Existence Without Extension — infinite subdivision, zero measure infinite set
Fractal_KochSierpinski: Infinite Perimeter, Fractal Dimension — Koch curve D≈1.26, Sierpinski triangle D≈1.585
Fractal_MengerSponge: Walkable Three-Dimensional Fractal — D≈2.727, infinite surface zero volume
Fractal_GoldenSpiral: Fibonacci and Phyllotaxis — golden ratio, 137.5°, romanesco
Fractal_Synthesis: What exactly is repeated? — compare procedures and prepare symbolic rewriting
